The deadlock finally broke again in the 78th minute when substitute Nicolas Ngamaleu turned provider, setting up Nikolas Ioannou to put Pafos ahead for the first time. Just as the hosts looked set for victory, Dinamo Tirana found another gear. In the 87th minute, Ruben Richards capped a brilliant individual performance by scoring the equalizer to make it 2-2 and force extra time. Extra Time Heroics and Final Blows The additional 30 minutes became a war of attrition, marked by a flurry of yellow cards for players including Pepe , David Luiz , and Samy Mmaee . With fatigue setting in, individual quality made the difference. In the 116th minute, Nicolas Ngamaleu went from provider to protagonist, scoring a crucial third goal for Pafos . As the clock ticked into stoppage time of extra time, Anderson Silva clinicaly added a fourth in the 120+1 minute to seal a 4-2 victory, ending a night of incredible drama for the home supporters.
